project.name: TINKAR Nid Check
project.description: A javac plugin, NidCheck, that fails the build on the nid hazards the compiler accepts when nids widen from int to long: a long passed to a lookup in a collection of Integer, an (int) cast of a nid outside Nid, and Nid.narrowChecked outside the classes allowed to narrow (design-2026-09-30-64-bit-nids).
